mapper.sql: SELECT it.category AS itemClass, -- 항목분류 / カテゴリ it.item_name AS itemName, -- 항목명 / 項目名 NVL(d.amount,0) AS amount, -- 금액(일반) / 金額(一般) NVL(d.expected_amount,0) AS expectedAmount, -- 예상공제금액 / 予想控除額 h.tax_apply_type AS taxApplyType, -- 세액적용유형 / 税額適用タイプ h.tax_apply_result AS taxApplyResult, -- 세액적용결과 / 税額適用結果 h.confirm_yn AS confirmYn -- 확정여부 / 確定フラグ FROM yrt_header h JOIN yrt_detail d ON d.yrt_id = h.yrt_id JOIN yrt_item it ON it.yrt_item_id = d.yrt_item_id WHERE h.emp_id = ( SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND h.base_year = #{baseYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select:
AND h.confirm_yn = ( SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM yrt_header h2 WHERE h2.emp_id = (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND h2.base_year = #{baseYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND h2.confirm_yn = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM dual )
ORDER BY it.category, it.item_name

SELECT h.yrt_id AS yrtId, #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS empId, h.base_year AS baseYear, h.tax_apply_type AS runLabel, h.confirm_yn AS confirmYn, h.created_at AS createdAt, h.created_at AS updatedAt FROM ( SELECT * FROM yrt_header WHERE emp_id = (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND base_year = #{baseYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND confirm_yn = 'Y' AND confirm_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC ) h WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT NVL(r.settle_income,0) AS addNational, NVL(r.settle_local ,0) AS addLocal FROM yrt_result_total r WHERE r.yrt_id = #{yrtId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_yrt.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO yrt_header ( yrt_id, emp_id, biz_place, base_year, tax_apply_type, tax_apply_result, confirm_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{yrtId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), '본사', #{baseYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{runLabel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, 'N', SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO yrt_detail d USING ( SELECT #{yrtId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS yrt_id, (SELECT it.yrt_item_id FROM yrt_item it WHERE it.category = #{cls, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND it.item_name = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS yrt_item_id, #{amt, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS amount, #{exp, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS expected_amount FROM dual ) s ON (d.yrt_id = s.yrt_id AND d.yrt_item_id = s.yrt_item_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET d.amount = s.amount, d.expected_amount = s.expected_amount WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (yrt_id, yrt_item_id, amount, expected_amount) VALUES (s.yrt_id, s.yrt_item_id, s.amount, s.expected_amount)

MERGE INTO yrt_result_total r USING (SELECT #{yrtId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS yrt_id, #{nat, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS nat, #{loc, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS loc FROM dual) s ON (r.yrt_id = s.yrt_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET r.settle_income = s.nat, r.settle_local = s.loc, r.settle_total = s.nat + s.loc WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (yrt_id, settle_income, settle_local, settle_total) VALUES (s.yrt_id, s.nat, s.loc, s.nat + s.loc)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(d.expected_amount),0) FROM yrt_detail d JOIN yrt_item it ON it.yrt_item_id = d.yrt_item_id JOIN yrt_header h ON h.yrt_id = d.yrt_id WHERE h.emp_id = (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND h.base_year = #{baseYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND h.yrt_id = #{yrtId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND it.category LIKE '세액공제%'
